selection_basis: Mechanism structure, broad conventional indicator horizons, and MGC tick/session scale only. No MGC Validation result was observed before locking.

atr_trend_flip.rationale: ATR memory and band distance fully define the SuperTrend state; the grid ranges from highly reactive to slow and from tight to very wide bands.

channel_extreme_reversion.rationale: Joint EMA/ATR channel memory and envelope width dominate the frequency and extremity of Keltner entries.

compression_breakout.rationale: Compression rank horizon spans very local to multi-session 1H context; MGC breakout buffers span 0 to 1.5 index points.

gap_continuation.rationale: Both published eligibility gates are widened down to effectively disabled and up to highly selective to diagnose the zero-trade baseline.

gap_fade.rationale: Minimum absolute MGC gap and maximum ATR-normalized gap are the direct lower and upper eligibility bounds; the grid tests nearly all gaps through only large gaps.

ma_crossover_trend.rationale: The two EMA memories are the crossover itself; valid cells range from fast reactions to multi-session trend horizons.

momentum_confirmed_breakout.rationale: Breakout memory and trend-strength gate control structure and selectivity; ADX zero exposes the ungated boundary.

range_structure_reversion.rationale: Range memory and edge-zone depth directly define the equilibrium structure and how far into it entries are allowed.

regression_equilibrium_reversion.rationale: Regression memory defines equilibrium while residual sigma controls displacement extremity from permissive to rare.

rolling_range_breakout.rationale: Entry and exit Donchian horizons are the mechanism's complete structural pair and cover fast through multi-session channels.

session_range_breakout.rationale: Opening-range duration covers the first 5 minutes through two hours of Gold activity; MGC buffers cover 0 to 1.5 points.

short_horizon_pullback_reversion.rationale: RSI memory and symmetric oversold/overbought threshold dominate pullback frequency and extremity.

statistical_zscore_reversion.rationale: Estimation memory and z-score displacement are the native statistical structure and entry gate.

trend_pullback_ma_structure.rationale: The first three and last two EMA groups retain the published 8:13:21 and 34:55 proportions while independently spanning fast and slow Gold trend structures.

volatility_breakout.rationale: Daily volatility memory and opening displacement span reactive to slow normalization and permissive to very selective MGC entries.

vwap_equilibrium_reversion.rationale: VWAP deviation controls extremity and completed 5-minute bars control intraday formation from 5 minutes to 4 hours.
